def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Forward with adaptive temperature scaling."""
        logits = self.model(x)
        
        # Infer perturbation levels
        with torch.no_grad():
            perturb_levels = torch.tensor(
                [self._infer_perturbation_level(x[i]) for i in range(len(x))],
                device=logits.device
            )
        
        # Apply temperature scaling
        bin_indices = (perturb_levels * self.num_bins).long().clamp(0, self.num_bins - 1)
        temps = self.temperature.to(logits.device)[bin_indices].reshape(-1, 1)
        
        return logits / temps
